system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The ControllerAgent calls a CorrectorSubAgent that proposes the next solution given the 'current' code and feedback, execution history and the result of tool calls.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts in App. H not in evidence; per-step prompt composed from code, feedback, history and tool outputs.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: includes the list of valid physics interfaces and features under them in addition to the one-shot example
env_context_strategy.note: PhyDoc list injected up front plus retrieval/query tools (RetrieveAnnotatedSnippets, QueryModelTreeProperties) used by ToolLookupAgent; closest value for API documentation injection.

context_compaction.note: Only paper available; no config surface.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The API returns a 'reply' to each line of code in the parsed LLM solution.
observation_format.note: QueryModelTreeProperties returns a dictionary; rendered as text in Fig. 3.

tool_call_format.note: Tool-call syntax not described in main text; solutions are Java API code (code_as_action-like) but parser not shown.

tool_count.evidence_quote: The tool registry consists of a retriever tool RetrieveAnnotatedSnippets, a tool that queries the API to return a dictionary of properties under a specified node QueryModelTreeProperties and two tools that return the list of valid physics interfaces and
tool_count.note: 4 tools in ToolLookupAgent registry; COMSOL execution not counted as a tool.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: a CorrectorSubAgent that proposes the next solution given the 'current' code and feedback
edit_primitive.note: Each correction emits a full new solution.

tool_schema_source.note: Paper only; schema source not described.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: we adopt an algorithmic sequence of agent calls except within the ToolLookupAgent. An initial set of 20 samples are generated using PhyDoc In-Context and the best solutions are corrected for 20 steps
loop_primitives.note: ToolLookupAgent is a free tool-calling loop (react-like), not explicitly stated.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: we adopt an algorithmic sequence of agent calls except within the ToolLookupAgent

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The ControllerAgent calls a CorrectorSubAgent that proposes the next solution given the 'current' code and feedback, execution history and the result of tool calls. It in turn delegates tool calls to the ToolLookupAgent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: It in turn delegates tool calls to the ToolLookupAgent.
delegation_mechanism.note: Unclear whether new conversations are created per call; closest value.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The system is equipped with an Evaluator whose feedback is used to compute a 'fitness' for each solution. This is used to track the best solutions.

long_term_memory.note: Annotated Library is a static retrieval corpus, not cross-run memory; no config surface.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we call a VerifierLLM to provide feedback (Figure 3, left panel) when executability crosses 90%.
self_verification.note: test_execution = harness executes code in COMSOL API and feeds back per-line replies.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: the best solutions are corrected for 20 steps

rollback.note: Best-solution tracking, but no rollback mechanism described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: the best solutions are corrected for 20 steps (see Appendix C.2 for details). The best of all solutions is then identified and evaluated.

execution_isolation.note: Python-COMSOL bridge in App. D.1 not in evidence.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The benchmark problems for FEABench Gold and the code are available at FEABench
eval_hooks.note: Agent released with the benchmark and its evaluation metrics; repo not inspected.

target_domain.evidence_quote: a benchmark to evaluate the ability of large language models (LLMs) and LLM agents to simulate and solve physics, mathematics and engineering problems using finite element analysis (FEA)

open_source.note: Code said to be available but no LICENSE in evidence; requires proprietary COMSOL.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Three closed-source LLMs – Claude-3.5-Sonnet (Anthropic), GPT-4o (OpenAI) and Gemini-1.5-Pro
model_agnostic.note: Multiple providers evaluated at baseline; agent run with Gemini-1.5-Pro only.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: The code is available at FEABench
primary_artifact.note: No repo_url/version in evidence; coded from paper.

pinned_version.note: No repo URL or version given.
